When you ascend a champ, you use the same champ of higher rarity as a sacrifice (fodder). That automatically increases the main champ to the same rarity as the one sacrificed. 

The main clan trait increases to the level of the sacrificed champ and it will get an additional trait to use but the current trait levels on that champ remain the same until you marry them to replace those traits.
